name: Hayasaka Shin'ichi
source:
Shinichi has lost his mother at a young age and lived with his aunt and uncle on an island until he was 10 years old.

Now he returns to the island due to being transferred there. The fact that he has been in love with his aunt for a very long time complicates his life.
